name: Frontend UI
description: React pages and components (Pages -> Components in the documented frontend architecture) that render the Travel Life interface, plus the app entry point, global styles, and static/public assets.

name: Frontend State & Hooks
description: Zustand stores and custom React hooks that manage client-side state and encapsulate reusable stateful logic consumed by pages and components.

name: Frontend Services & Types
description: Service modules wrapping the backend REST API (Services -> API in the documented frontend architecture), the axios/query-client/offline-storage library layer, shared TypeScript types/constants, and frontend test fixtures/mocks.

name: Backend API Layer
description: Express routes, controllers, and middleware forming the Routes -> Controllers stage of the documented backend architecture: the HTTP request/response pipeline, auth guards, rate limiting, and error handling.

name: Backend Service Layer
description: Core business-logic services (Services stage of the documented backend architecture) plus the auth/security/validation helpers, HTTP and error utilities, config bootstrapping, static reference data, backend type definitions, and test fixtures/mocks that support them.

name: Data Layer
description: The Prisma schema, generated Prisma client helpers, and the full history of 40+ SQL migrations that define and evolve the PostgreSQL/PostGIS database schema (Prisma Client -> Database stage of the documented backend architecture).

name: Infrastructure & Config
description: Dockerfiles, docker-compose stacks (including TrueNAS variants), CI/CD workflows, build/release/deploy scripts, and project-level build configuration (tsconfig, package.json, Vite/Tailwind/ESLint/Jest config, env examples) for both the frontend and backend services.

name: Documentation
description: Project documentation: the docs/ knowledge base (architecture, API reference, guides, plans, user guide), top-level READMEs/deployment guides, and service-level README/output files.

name: Vendored Reference Docs
description: Third-party Vercel React/React Native best-practices reference documentation vendored under .agent/skills/*/rules/ — not Travel Life application code, kept separate so it is not conflated with the project's real architecture.
